name: anhedral
description: Create, update and extend Anhedral Stack projects using the Anhedral CLI.

interface.longDescription: Create editable web UI, update existing generated source while preserving authored changes, add backend services, and authenticate/build/deploy through the separately configured CLI. Skills guide reviewed terminal commands.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the Anhedral Stack, start it locally and open it in my browser.
Update this Anhedral Stack project while preserving my changes, run its checks, then authenticate and deploy it.
